21q22.2; FUS::ERG in AML, ERG deletion in DUX4-r B-ALL.
8q24.21; Ig-locus hijack in B-ALL, TR-locus hijack in T-ALL.
19p13.3; PBX1, HLF and ZNF384 partners. PBX1 is off-panel.
9q34.13; DEK, SET and ABL1 partners across AML and T-ALL.
16q24.3; GLIS2, RUNX1, NFIA and PAX5 partners.
10q24.31; TR-locus hijack defines the TLX1 T-ALL subtype.
11p13; TR-locus hijack or non-coding enhancer deletion.
Xp22.33/Yp11.32; IGH::CRLF2 or P2RY8::CRLF2 PAR1 deletion.
17q21.31; UBTF-TD is an exon-13 tandem duplication, not a fusion. Detect as an intragenic DUP/INS, not a junction to a partner.
6q23.3; MYB duplication as well as TRB::MYB.
